svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 04/12 Inverted Fountain (Uncommon)
svg.desc: The water falls in instead of shooting up. Sit on the rim and listen to it tumble. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
